title: Duckduckgo Installs Are Up 30 As Users Reject Being Force Fed Googles Ai Search
report:
**Summary (4 sentences)**

Google's recent overhaul of its search engine, incorporating more AI features, has sparked a backlash from users who prefer a traditional search experience. In response, many are turning to DuckDuckGo, a privacy-focused alternative that allows users to opt out of AI features. DuckDuckGo has seen a significant surge in app installs and website traffic, with some metrics showing a 30% week-over-week growth rate. The company's CEO, Gabriel Weinberg, attributes the growth to Google's force-feeding of AI without an option to opt out.

**Key Facts (5)**

1. **Google's Search Overhaul**: Google transformed its search box into a conversational engine that uses AI Overviews to answer questions directly and anticipates user intent.
2. **DuckDuckGo Growth**: DuckDuckGo saw an 18.1% week-over-week growth rate in U.S. app installs, with some metrics peaking at 30.5%, following Google's announcement.
3. **AI-Free Search Page**: DuckDuckGo offers a dedicated AI-free search page (noai.duckduckgo.com) that turns off all AI features by default, which has seen an average week-over-week growth rate of 22.7%.
4. **Third-Party Validation**: App analytics company Apptopia reported a 29% increase in average daily downloads for DuckDuckGo in the U.S. and a 12% increase globally over the same period.
5. **Market Share**: Despite its recent growth, DuckDuckGo still only accounts for around 2% of the U.S. search market, far behind Google's dominant share.
